sources.entry: skill-optimizer — CLI tool that benchmarks SKILL.md guidance docs against multiple LLMs, measures whether models call the right SDK/CLI/MCP tools with correct arguments, and runs an iterative optimizer to rewrite your docs until every configured model meets a score floor. MIT.

summary.one_liner: A Docker-based eval workbench and Agent Skill that runs deterministic, grader-checked evals of agent skills against OpenRouter models via a local CLI.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides an Agent Skill (skills/skill-optimizer/SKILL.md) that can be installed into several coding agents to help author and debug eval suites. It also includes a local CLI that runs cases and suites inside Docker against OpenRouter models. A case is a user-like task plus deterministic graders; a suite is a matrix of cases and models. The agent phase sees only an isolated /work directory populated from references/, while graders run afterward and check files, command logs, SQL results, artifacts, answer.json, or trace.jsonl. The README's examples include PDF extraction/splitting/creation cases and an MCP example that runs a local calculator server as a hidden Docker service. Detailed workbench behavior is documented in docs/workbench.md, which the README does not reproduce.
use_cases: author eval suites for an agent skill
debug why an agent misuses a skill
run a task suite against several OpenRouter models
check whether an agent follows SKILL.md instructions
test PDF handling instructions for an agent
evaluate an MCP server through an agent workflow
how_to_run: export OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... (required for real model runs)
notable: Installable as a skill/plugin across Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI
Deterministic graders run after the agent phase and inspect workspace files, answer.json, trace.jsonl, and SQL state
Agent phase is isolated to /work so hidden answers and graders are not visible to the agent
Suites are a matrix of cases crossed with OpenRouter models
Includes a negative case checking the agent did not read an unrelated skill file
caveats: Only openrouter/... model refs are supported
Real model runs require an OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Requires Docker and Node.js 20+ installed locally
